decisions.reason: A semi-hard cheese wheel sits squarely in the firm's core cheese-making know-how, so the firm can read its sales results and refine it, and it was promoted to its own page in 2019, which suggests it gained traction.

The spicy cheese is a flavour variant built on existing cheese processes and was given its own page in 2019, so the firm can interpret and adjust its results; flavoured lines carry somewhat higher delisting risk, as the dropped onion-and-pepper cheese shows.

The mild creamy soft cheese rounded out the new range under a named brand and builds on related soft-cheese knowledge; unlike the washed-rind variant it survived into 2019 with its own page, which indicates the firm absorbed what worked.
